describes: `409` · `DAILY_CAP_EXCEEDED`. Issuing a refund past the caller's 24-hour limit. Contract-only for `issueRefund`: `services/hg` escalates such a refund to an approval request (202, `refund_approval_request_pending`) instead; it answers this code when approving (`error_refund_approver_over_daily_limit`).

error.message: This refund would take you past your 24-hour refund limit.
